title: A mobile bottom tab bar
notes: Phones now get a bottom navigation tab bar — Home, Search, a centre “Post” button, notifications and your account, with unread badges. Admins configure it under Settings → “Mobile tab bar”: toggle it, choose which tabs appear, and reorder them.

changelog.text: Configurable mobile bottom tab bar — quick nav on phones with a raised compose button and unread badges; admins pick and reorder the tabs in Settings.
